description: Read a notebook’s sharing status, or toggle its public link. Omit `set_public` to just read status (public link on/off, owner/collaborators). Set `set_public: true`/`false` to enable/disable the public link. RPC-backed (no browser).

set_public.description: Optional. true = enable public link, false = restrict. Omit to only read status.

name: share_notebook

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
